summary: Iteration 5 tested: (1) Backend GET /api/wa-log filters (search/status/limit) - all 11 filter tests pass with correct role gating (admin only). (2) Frontend Pengaturan WA log search + status filter buttons work end-to-end, correctly re-fetch from backend. (3) Rapor 'Unduh PDF' button triggers real client-side PDF download (Rapor-<name>.pdf) via html2canvas+jsPDF - no console errors. (4) Role redirects intact: siswa cannot access /pengaturan or /rapor. All 14 pytest cases pass; all frontend interaction checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Rapor.jsx downloadPdf uses document.querySelector('[data-testid="rapor-content"]') which will pick the first sheet only if user is in Cetak Sekelas mode (multi rapor). Currently button is disabled unless single-student data is loaded, so OK, but if requirements change to allow class PDF, this needs update.
exportPdf.js uses JPEG at scale=2 which produces reasonably sized files, but text may become slightly blurry on multi-page rapor; consider PNG or vector-based approach if fidelity becomes an issue.
